comments.body:
I suspect this relates to the changes in https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export-verify/commit/bfd6fa1d809002236850c402be6ac7317ea2397f

The refactored fedoraResource class in this commit assigns a 'type' property, but not 'ldp_type'.

This commit partially fixes this issue, but not completely: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export-verify/pull/38/commits/8d84e61fc9253b6c71532da54f52c00186b9ba48

To fix this properly I think we need two things:

  1. we need to document the contract of import-export and precisely what its config options represent for the various scenarios
  2. we probably need to refactor the two main resource classes (fedoraResource and localResource) so that all possible errors are handled appropriately

Joshua Allan Westgard I tested it and I got "Verification complete" message. The "AttributeError" error is gone. Here is the log:
$ fcrepo-verify importexport.yml
2017-05-26 16:42:52,556 INFO Loading configuration options from importexport.yml
2017-05-26 16:42:52,556 INFO Loaded the following configuration options:
2017-05-26 16:42:52,557 INFO --> mode : import
2017-05-26 16:42:52,557 INFO --> predicates : http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#contains
2017-05-26 16:42:52,557 INFO --> resource : http://localhost:8686/f4/rest
2017-05-26 16:42:52,557 INFO --> source : http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest
2017-05-26 16:42:52,557 INFO --> map : http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest,http://localhost:8686/f4/rest
2017-05-26 16:42:52,557 INFO --> dir : /Users/lsitu/Documents/Fedora_Import_Export/data_1bbb_v48
2017-05-26 16:42:52,557 INFO --> binaries : True
2017-05-26 16:42:52,557 INFO --> inbound : False
2017-05-26 16:42:52,557 INFO --> rdfLang : text/turtle
2017-05-26 16:42:52,557 INFO Testing connection to http://localhost:8686...
2017-05-26 16:42:52,575 INFO Connection successful.
2017-05-26 16:42:52,575 INFO Starting verification...
2017-05-26 16:42:52,575 INFO Running verification on Fedora 4 import
2017-05-26 16:42:52,576 INFO Commencing resource verification...
2017-05-26 16:43:00,149 INFO Verified 1008 resources: successes = 0, failures = 1008
2017-05-26 16:43:00,149 INFO Verification complete

Thanks, Situ, Longshou, based on the configuration options chosen, this is the expected result with the current version of the verification tool. The tool does not deal with the "map" option correctly yet. Thanks for testing!
Joshua Allan Westgard: Should this ticket be closed with the following PR: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export-verify/pull/40
Andrew Woods, yes based on testing by Situ, Longshou, that PR appears to resolve this issue too.

resource: http://localhost:8686/f4/rest
source: http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest
